title: EoP Check
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM
EoP Check

Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable determines rule variants for company code and application object from posting area
1140. So, you assign a rule variant to the application objects in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under

Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable » Technical Settings > Data Protection » Specify Determination of Rule Variants

(eo)

*° Example
You use a rule variant for a company code representing a legal entity such as a subsidiary in the same or another country
adhering to different legal requirements for retention periods.

Technical Details
EoP Check Implementation
To block business partners with the contract partner role (MKK):

1. Check whether business partner data is still relevant for business activities using the mass activity Check Whether
Business Partner Data Can Be Blocked (transaction FPDPR1 in the SAP menu under |}Periodic Processing » For Data
Protection 33).

i Note

The audit area BUPA_DP must be productive for the ILM object CA_BUPA and the policy category Residence Rules
(transaction ILMARA).

If the check finds that business partner data is no longer required, the program derives the appropriate rule variant from
Customizing.

The program calculates the end of residence time (representing the EoP) based on the residence periods maintained for
the ILM object CA_BUPA that is active for the audit area BUPA_DP for the application MKK and the existing rule variants.

This information is made available to the blocking transaction Block Master Data (Business Partner) (BUPA_PRE_ EOP).

2. Block business partner data no longer required by business activities using transaction Block Master Data (Business
Partner) (BUPA PRE EOP).

For more information, see chapter Blocking and Unblocking of Business Partners.

Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable uses the following tables:

Tables Used to Store Data Relevant for Blocking

Technical Name of Table                                                                             Use

DFKKDPR_BP                                                                               These transparent tables store the start of retention time (SORT)

as calculated by the check program (transaction FPDPR1).
DFKKDPR_BP_SORT

The information in these tables is processed by the blocking
program.

DFKKDPR_BP_ROLE                                                                       This database table is an index table for documents with business
partners with more than one role, for example, contract partner and
